preconditions.description: The number of stones n is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 and 1 <= b_i <= 10**9 and 1 <= c_i <= 10**9 for a_i, b_i, c_i in stones)
preconditions.description: Each stone's edge sizes a_i, b_i, and c_i are between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.description: The number of stones chosen k is either 1 or 2.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= stone_index <= n for stone_index in chosen_stones)
postconditions.description: All chosen stone indices are within the range [1, n].
All chosen stone indices are distinct.

postconditions.expression: max_sphere_radius >= max(max(min(a_i, b_i, c_i) / 2 for a_i, b_i, c_i in stones), max(min(a_i + a_j, b_i + b_j, c_i + c_j) / 2 for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n) if any(a_i == a_j or a_i == b_j or a_i == c_j or b_i == a_j or b_i == b_j or b_i == c_j or c_i == a_j or c_i == b_j or c_i == c_j)))
postconditions.description: The radius of the largest possible sphere that can be carved from the chosen stones is maximized.
